invitation.unavailableDescription: This invitation link is invalid or has expired.
invitation.cancelled: This event has been cancelled by the organizer.

rsvp.transferredSomeone: You handed this invitation to someone else.
rsvp.transferredHint: Their own invitation is on its way, and this ticket is no longer valid at the entrance.
rsvp.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

transfer.title: Transfer your ticket
transfer.description: They'll get their own invitation and this ticket will no longer be valid for you.
transfer.invalid: Please check the recipient's details and try again.
transfer.closed: This place can no longer be transferred: transfers have closed, or the ticket has already been used at the entrance.
transfer.contactRequired: Give the recipient an email address or a phone number.

erasure.title: Delete your personal data?
erasure.description: This permanently removes your name, email and phone number from this event. It cannot be undone. The organizer keeps only an anonymous record that a guest was invited.
erasure.done: Your personal data has been deleted from this event. This cannot be undone.
erasure.doneToast: Your personal data has been deleted.
erasure.failed: We couldn't delete your data just now. Please try again.

ticket.unavailableDescription: This link is invalid or has expired.
ticket.noneDescription: Confirm your attendance to get your ticket.
ticket.offline: Keep this page or a screenshot: the ticket shows without a connection and is presented at the entrance.
ticket.brightness: Turn your screen brightness up for a quick scan.
ticket.cancelled: This event has been cancelled: this ticket is no longer valid.
